name: FLA_INTERFACE_REJECTIONS
description: FLA_INTERFACE_REJECTIONS  contains the error details captured during import program

columns.name: INTERFACE_REJECTION_ID
columns.description: Interface Rejection Record identifier. Primary Key Column.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERFACE_LEASE_ID
columns.description: Interface Lease Identifier referenced from FLA_LEASES_INT table

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Object type identifiers. Contains values like LEASE, ASSETS, ASSETSERIALS, PAYMENTHEADER, PAYMENTLINE and PAYMENTACCOUNTS etc

columns.name: OBJECT_KEY_ID1
columns.description: Key value corresponding to Object type column. Contains values corresponding to INTERFACE_LEASE_ID, INTERFACE_PAYMENT_HEADER_ID, INTERFACE_ASSET_ID, INTERFACE_SERIAL_ID, INTERFACE_PAYMENT_LINE_ID and INTERFACE_PAYMENT_ACCOUNT_ID.

columns.name: OBJECT_KEY_ID2
columns.description: Contains any other reference keys corresponding to error.

columns.name: OBJECT_REFERENCE1
columns.description: Reference value for rejection reference purpose.

columns.name: OBJECT_REFERENCE2
columns.description: Reference value for rejection reference purpose.

columns.name: OBJECT_REFERENCE3
columns.description: Reference value for rejection reference purpose. This will capture the columns which are referenced.

columns.name: OBJECT_REFERENCE4
columns.description: Reference value for rejection reference purpose. This will capture the objects or lookups which are referenced.

columns.name: MESSAGE_CODE
columns.description: Message code that provides the reason for rejection of a record.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TEXT
columns.description: Detailed error message which was captured.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
